messages:
maya: Hey team — quick ping for review on PR #432: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432. Adds an embeddings quickstart example and a few small lint/snippet fixes in the SDK examples. Can someone take a look? TL;DR: 1) new `examples/embed_quickstart.md` 2) fix async/await in JS + Python snippet 3) README wording tweak. Ping @ali @sam for docs & SDK eyes. :pray:

ali: I'll take a look in ~30m. if CI is green and no major issues I can approve after a tiny wording nit.

devdocs-bot: CI: ✅ all checks passed (build, lint, docs-link-check) — run at 1782108001

sam: quick skim: JS snippet looks like it's missing an `await` in the example. Also we should show the `async` wrapper in the snippet, otherwise readers get confused.

maya: good catch, thanks. I intended to keep the snippet minimal but agree we should include the `async` context. I'll push a change to the JS example.

jordan: small Python suggestion — the example currently calls `client.embed(...)` synchronously. in our py sdk examples we generally demonstrate `async` usage. Suggest showing both a sync and async variant or at least the async variant with `await`:
```python
# before
emb = client.embed("hello world")

# suggested
async def run():
    emb = await client.embed("hello world")
```
Also add a 1-line note: "Run inside an async function or event loop."

maya: thanks @jordan — I'll add that note and the async wrapper. pushing now.

maya: pushed -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432/files#diff-abc123. Changes: updated JS snippet to show `async` wrapper, updated python example to use `await`, small README wording tweak.

nick: LGTM :thumbsup: — nice and clear.

ali: saw the push. One tiny nit in README: replace "then call embed" with "then call `embed` on the client" for clarity. non-blocking for me though.

maya: done, README tweak pushed.

maya: planning to merge in ~10m if no objections. Thanks for the quick reviews everyone.

sam: no objections, go ahead and merge. :shipit:

maya: merged. closing the loop — thanks again!
